answer: The karst holds work receipts rather than names, so the garden of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The saffron of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
